capabilities: Search note titles, paths and aliases with fuzzy matching
Show recently opened notes with relative timestamps
Pin frequently used notes as a reorderable card board
Create new notes, including in folders, from the search box
Customize greeting, hero image, visible sections and layout
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or newer. Runs entirely locally with no network requests or analytics; releases carry GitHub build provenance attestations. Supports English and Spanish, desktop and mobile, and can be installed via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian opens new tabs empty, giving no starting point to search the vault or resume recently opened notes.

relations.evidence: Shift + Enter | Search note content with Obsidian's core Search plugin
BRAT installs Foyer straight from GitHub. It is an alternative to the directory

summary: Start page that replaces empty new tabs with fuzzy title search, a recent-notes list, a pinboard of frequently used notes, and a time-of-day greeting.
